name: SirFancyBacon Mod Pack
author: SirFancyBacon (ported to MoonMod by Jeffiest)
description: Quality-of-life ideas from SirFancyBacon's Chronicle branches (qol-pack, floor-select), as a MoonMod mod. An Auto Repair Powder in your bag saves a weapon about to break, as one in a quick slot does. T mends the active weapon with a Repair Powder from the bag. The dungeon's floor list warns, before you go in, of a floor that lets only one character in, locks your weapon, or dries you out faster. Each part has its own setting.

settings.name: Auto Repair Powder works from the bag
T mends the weapon with a Repair Powder from the bag
The floor list warns of limited floors
